task.description:
Implement the fix for ISS-0114 per the validated design at src/design/iss-0114-fix.md. Five changes required:

1. src/db/pool.zig :: applyRequestStorageRouting — add resolveAndCacheStorageMode fallback: when SELECT storage_mode FROM public.tenant WHERE id=$1 returns 0 rows, query public.tenant_schemas for that tenant_id; if found, treat as SCHEMA mode. This is the resolver fallback heuristic that prevents sticky LEGACY_RLS routing for freshly-provisioned tenants.

2. src/db/provisioning.zig :: provisionTenantSchema — after bpm_provision_tenant_schema succeeds, INSERT INTO public.tenant (id, storage_mode) VALUES ($1, 'SCHEMA') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET storage_mode='SCHEMA' WHERE public.tenant.storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS' OR public.tenant.storage_mode IS NULL. Then call tenant_context_mod.setStorageMode(.SCHEMA). New ProvisionError.SchemaPromotionFailed variant on INSERT failure.

3. migrations/1135_iss0114_backfill_public_tenant_storage_mode.sql — backfill migration: for every row in public.tenant_schemas that has no matching public.tenant row OR has storage_mode != 'SCHEMA', upsert with storage_mode='SCHEMA'. Idempotent.

4. src/db/migrations.zig :: runForSchema — add SHOW search_path post-condition assertion after SET LOCAL; verify result includes tenant_<uuid>. If absent, return MigrationError.SchemaSetupFailed.

5. tests/integration/setup.zig (or equivalent fixture file) — ensure tenant_context.clear() is invoked per-test so threadlocal state from a prior test does not leak into the next test's first pool checkout.

Follow Zig conventions per docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md. Use prepared statements only (no SQL string interpolation). Match signatures from the design's Public Interface section.

REWORK 1 (per TEST-RUNNER step 5 FAIL):
- [BLOCKER] src/db/provisioning.zig Step 6a INSERT INTO public.tenant only sets id + storage_mode, but public.tenant has 7 NOT NULL columns (id, slug, display_name, status, created_at, updated_at, storage_mode, tenant_type). Insert fails with C23502 'null value in column slug' for every fresh tenant; this propagates as SchemaPromotionFailed and 107 downstream test failures.
- [BLOCKER] migrations/1135_iss0114_backfill_public_tenant_storage_mode.sql has the same defect: only id, storage_mode, created_at inserted. Will fail when applied against current schema.
- [BLOCKER] TC-DB-03-01 fails with StoreError.InstanceNotFound — downstream of the above.
- [MAJOR] lint_test_isolation.py reports 222 BLOCKER + 19 MAJOR on tests/integration — pre-existing baseline drift, NOT introduced by this fix. Per git blame, the violations originate at commit c4e66ca (2026-05-21). Scope note: do NOT block this fix on it, but the harness signal must be acknowledged.

Required fix:
  Step 6a: INSERT INTO public.tenant (id, slug, display_name, status, tenant_type, storage_mode) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'ACTIVE', 'production', 'SCHEMA') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET storage_mode='SCHEMA' WHERE public.tenant.storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS' OR public.tenant.storage_mode IS NULL. Use a stable slug derived from the tenant_id (e.g. 'tenant-' || encode($1::bytea, 'hex')) or accept slug as a parameter.
  Migration 1135 must match. Pass slug/display_name/tenant_type as either derived from tenant_id or via a (SELECT t.tenant_id, t.storage_mode FROM public.tenant_schemas t) subquery that pulls existing columns.
  Look up the actual NOT NULL columns of public.tenant via information_schema.columns and read the schema thoroughly before patching.

After fix, re-run zig build test + zig build migrate. Integration test verification belongs to TEST-RUNNER, NOT back to you — BACKEND-DEV stops at clean build + migrate.
